_comment: Server configuration (roadmap 1.12 F12, arch-config). Every key is optional; config.py holds the defaults and validates types. Restart the server after editing.
_client_comment: client-2009-login: CLIENT_BUILD "2008" (WindSlayer2Game client, the default) or "2009" (EN Outspark v1.04 Build 14, data in CLIENT_DIR_2009): version code 14, channel entries carry GAME_PORT, login is the launcher field -<account> <password> -x -x (WindSlayer2009/play_2009.bat).
_version_comment: lc-version-config: NOTICE is the S2C 0x01 announcement (<=1000 bytes; the launcher shows its first line). MAINTENANCE sends version_code 0xEA61 instead of 3 - the client shows the notice and closes itself 5 s later - and answers every login with 0x02 result 0x0E.
NOTICE:
Press start button to start the game.

_mob_comment: world-1a-defaults: MOB_SPAWN_EFFECT_ID 0 sends no S2C 0x1A effect entry (live T-1A-1: idle mobs render without one; 2875 restores the old Mutation entry). MOB_SERVER_CONTROLLED false lets the client wander AI walk mobs (retail); hits come from the client's own 61 B C2S 0x0D reports, so the server needs no mob position. true keeps them idle where the server put them.
_ground_comment: item_inventory-ground-loot-pickup (P4 stage 2): GROUND_LOOT true drops monster loot on the ground (S2C 0x12) for the pickup key (C2S 0x1F -> S2C 0x13); false restores the P0 loot-into-the-bag path until the ground flow is live-verified. Unpicked items despawn after GROUND_ITEM_SECS; a map holds at most GROUND_ITEMS_PER_MAP (the oldest goes first).
_crafting_comment: P4 stage 3 (item_inventory-crafting / -reinforcement / -gathering): Concoction and Mineral Refining roll the client's own success table (no key). REINFORCE_SUCCESS_PCT is the reinforcement success chance (retail unknown; a failure consumes nothing). GATHER_RATE_DIVISOR is the unit of a gather node's hni Drop column (100000: ~65% of gathers find something; 0: every gather yields a reward, weighted by the column). The tool is used up on every gather result.
_cards_comment: P4 stage 4 (quest_cards_misc-card-exp-bonus / -system-notice-0x99): CARD_EXP_BONUS gives +10% exp (at least 1) for kills of a monster whose Monster Card is registered in the Card Deck (the card tooltip; retail unproven). CHANNEL_NOTICE sends S2C 0x99 sub 8 'In channel N.' once per connection, after the enter-world burst (on the client's first C2S 0x63).
_events_comment: P13 stage 1 (events.py): EVENTS_FILE names the event schedule ('' = none; events.json ships the disabled P13 exit-criteria event 'p13-exit': set this to "events.json", then '!event start p13-exit' or enabled true). EVENT_EXP_QUESTS also scales quest exp by the event multiplier. EVENT_RELOGIN_QUIET_SECS: a relog of the same character within it repeats neither the entry [Announcement] nor the Event News popup (the login gift is claimed per character for good).
_event_quests_comment: P13 stage 2 (ev-e5): an event's push_quests go out as S2C 0x26 on its first world entry and chain through the hqi NextQuest after each turn-in at Nicolas (C2S 0x17 -> 0x27 + 0x21 [+ 0x3F], then 0x26 of the next: 158 -> 159 -> 160). Only quests with plain-ASCII quest-log texts are pushed (the 2009 chain 158-160); EVENT_QUEST_KOREAN_TEXT true also pushes the Korean-text ones (232-291, and the 2008 hqi's 158-161), which show as CP949 bytes in the EN client.
_bosses_comment: P13 stage 3 (bosses.py, boss-b1/b2): a monster tile whose map value_num is in BOSS_TILE_VALUES is a field boss (11 tiles in the 2009 maps: Rynx 218, Monkey King 409, 2 Wasablanca 511, Leo Wolf 619, Drill Mole 819, Wook 920, the frogs 1017/1018/1021, Blue Shark 1111). It respawns value_num * BOSS_RESPAWN_SCALE s after its death (300 s); the time is kept in BOSS_LEDGER_FILE next to accounts.json ('' = memory only), so leaving the map, its discard and a server restart are no free respawn. GM !boss lists the ledger, !boss respawn [all|<map>|<name>] brings a down boss back now. DROP_MODE: 'rates' rolls every hni Drop entry at rate / DROP_RATE_UNIT (a boss trophy 99.99 %), 'single' one draw over the column (at most one item), 'legacy' the old 60 % uniform pick. Loot stays the killer's for 15 s.
_boss_combat_comment: P13 stage 4 (boss-b3): which monsters the chase may command attack B (S2C 0x2A lo 15/16, AI[8], Strong_Atk hits) and the dash (lo 19/1A, AI[3]): "all" (every template with the flag), "bosses" (only the field bosses above), "off" (never). Attack A (lo 05/06) is live-verified, B and the dash are not yet (T-B3): switch one off if the live check shows it misbehaving. Monkey Lord (hni 140) has neither flag and swings attack A only.
_aggro_comment: monster aggro (MONSTER_AGGRO_RE_2026-09-23): MOB_AGGRO true = a hit monster turns on its attacker - the server keeps the hate list and drives it with command nodes (walk/jump/drop/attack by the client's own chase rules) until the target dies or leaves, the mob is MOB_LEASH_PX from where the chase began or 15 s pass without a hit, then S2C 0x9E hands it back. false = the old behaviour. MOB_AI_COMMAND "2A" (the 16-byte 0x2A self-form, default) or "1B" (0x1B {hold 300} nodes after the 0x2A release) - the live test decides which one the client honours. MOB_CONTACT_DAMAGE: the victim's own C2S 0x0D monster-hit reports damage the player (S2C 0x28, 0x3E at 0); MOB_CONTACT_AGGRO_ONLY: only from a monster that is after him (un-hit wandering mobs are harmless, as in retail).
_contact_rate_comment: livetest bug 2: MOB_CONTACT_MIN_SECS is the minimum time between two body-contact hits (C2S 0x0D events 1/6) of ONE monster on one player; monster swings (events 4/5, 7..10) keep their own 0.5 s slot. A touch from a monster in a commanded attack counts as contact too: the client checks contact before the swing, so a player pinned by a swinging mob is hurt by contact (P7 live L2). 0 = every reported touch.
_damage_comment: damage-formula: DAMAGE_FORMULA "client" (default) computes every hit with the client's own formula (damage.py: FUN_0041b830 stat derivation + FUN_004194f0 level scale, skill and element terms) - the number under the client's damage digit before its grade roll; "placeholder" restores the old STR + W_Att - Def / Body_Atk - Def rules for rollback.
_grade_roll_comment: livetest bug 10: DAMAGE_GRADE_ROLL rolls the 2009 combo HUD v2 patch's grade table (CRITICAL! x1.5 5%, BAD x0.75 13%, GOOD x1.25 13%, else x1.0; x0.9..1.1 jitter; truncated, >= 1 except BAD) on the server's value of a player's hit on a monster (swings, strong attacks, skills, traps, detonations; never DoT or monster hits). The client's digit and the server's value are independent draws with the same mean, not the same number per hit. null (auto, default) = on only for CLIENT_BUILD 2009: the roll is right only for a 2009 exe patched with the combo HUD (patch_2009.py); a 2008 exe, or a 2009 exe built with --no-combo-hud, draws the exact unrolled value and must run with it off. true / false force it.
_shared_mobs_comment: P5 stage 3 (world-shared-monsters): one set of monsters per map, the same uids on every client there; kills, corpses, respawns, chase words (0x2A per receiver) and hand-backs (0x9E) reach everyone on the map. A map nobody stands on keeps its monsters (dead ones stay dead) for MOB_MAP_KEEP_SECS, then they are rebuilt fresh on the next arrival; 0 = at once. GM !mobs lists them.
_desync_comment: Position sync between clients (desync fix plan 2026-09-28, POSITION_SYNC_RE); each switch alone, for a staged live rollout (one change per session: P1, M1, P2, P3), both builds. P1 RELAY_START_HOLD_GAP_MS: an S2C 0x1B node after idle words gets the 30 ms start hold only after more than this many ms (the builder's final idle packet), else its real elapsed time (0 = the legacy clamp after every idle node; else 240..990). P2 RELAY_SETTLE_NODE: once a mover's last relayed words are idle and no C2S 0x0D came for RELAY_SETTLE_AFTER_MS (>= 300), his holders get that node once more with hold RELAY_SETTLE_HOLD_MS (30..990) so a copy left floating lands. P3 POSITION_ESTIMATE_DASH_KNOCK: the server estimate follows dash (18 ticks, 364.5 px) / knockback / dash attack and stands still in the player's own hurt (state 3); MOB_SPEED_FROM_TEMPLATE: monsters are dead-reckoned at 1e7 / hni speed px/s (not 82.5 for all). M1 MOB_HIT_RELAY_KNOCKBACK: the 33-byte hit relay of a basic swing / dash attack (interact event 7) to the other clients carries the attacker's facing and the hurt so their copies slide 2 ticks and stun like the attacker's (false = the old flinch in place). MOB_HIT_HURT_PER_SWING: the hurt is what is left of the attacker's action at the hit, counted from his own 0x0D words (hitstun.py, HIT_STUN_PER_SWING_RE: swing 490, dash attack 760, Ice Spear 1020); false = MOB_HIT_RELAY_HURT_MS (0..4095) for every hit; a hit the server cannot classify gets a guess that errs high, never below it (event 9: the state-1 default, 1020 for a Warrior; a held attack key: 760). The tables are the 2009 client's (unverified for CLIENT_BUILD 2008). M3 MOB_HIT_RELAY_SKILL_VARIANT: a skill / strong-attack hit (event 9) is relayed as the 34-byte case-9 form (action 9 + the u8 cast variant, hi = the hurt): the watchers replay the 4-tick slide, stun, element and debuff (false = the old flinch in place; a Priest tier-2 Vampiric Attack is sent with flag 0, whose drain would hit the watchers' copies of the attacker). MOB_HIT_RECOVER_SECS: no chase word until the hit + max(this, stun + MOB_HIT_RECOVER_MARGIN_SECS (0.09..1)) after a client-caught swing or skill hit (the stun: hurt - 60 for a swing, hurt +1000 ice for a skill); 0 = no gate. MOB_HIT_CAST_GATE: an attack skill the server's box lands holds the chase from the cast for the skill's length L + the margin. MOB_HIT_ICE_CHASE_SECS: an ice-element skill hit (stun hurt + 1000) sends the first chase word this long after the hit (0 < x < 0.95; 0.6, the keep-alive cadence, leaves ~0.36 s of margin), before the copies' state machine stalls at the end of the 0x2A node's 960 ms hold - a queued word keeps them ticking and does not cut the stun short; it goes out even when the decision did not change (STOP included) and is kept alive until the stun ends (0 = the plain stun gate). Guarded hits (4) and trap catches (0xC) keep the flinch in place and set no gate.
_reputation_comment: P7 stage 3 (social_friend-compliment): popup Praise gives the target account COMPLIMENT_DELTA manner points. A giver compliments once per day; the same target account again only after COMPLIMENT_REPEAT_DAYS days (0 = no such rule); an account receives at most COMPLIMENT_DAILY_CAP a day. The report fee is the client's own ceil(level/10)*100 (not configurable: the client pre-checks it).
